scenario: M1 scenarios 8 and 10 (LV): the call opens with the Russian greeting; a Latvian caller's first sentence asks whether Anna is a real person. A full Latvian sentence in reply to the opening counts, so Anna must call language_detection (lv) before her first Latvian word.

chat_history.message: Здравствуйте. Это Анна, ИИ-ассистент Smart Comfort Group. Чем могу помочь?

success_condition: The agent calls language_detection with Latvian (lv) as the target before answering. One assertion only, the switch: the honest answer itself is asserted in Russian by t15 and judged on live calls by the no_human_claim criterion.
